body:
Finite bit-circuit construction; **no new kappa**. A global pass of restored helper stars on PR915's frozen target basis reduces the complete R439 word from PR926's **11,980 to 11,783 ADDs**, saving **197** including all preparation and restoration. A disjoint-pair control using the same seed costs 11,983, so the changed class saves 200 against that control. Only `research/r439-helper-stars-seed19/` is added.

The complete D bill is **221 + 306 + 4,509 + 306 + 221 = 5,563**. The candidate contains 64 three-helper stars and 93 single-edge components. All 439 helpers, nine copied totals, per-register MOVE paths, COPY/ERASE records and paid rank mass 5,129 are retained. Its positive bounds F = 72,847 and B = 10,394,084 satisfy the exact local 104-bit and nine-stage 192-bit expressions. The latter uses **99.996316%** of its ceiling; that narrow margin is explicit.

Reproduce offline with Python 3.10+ and the standard library:

```sh
python3 -I -B research/r439-helper-stars-seed19/verify.py
```

Expected: `PASS_R439_HELPER_STARS: 64 three-helper stars; ADDs 11980 -> 11783; 200 beyond same-seed pairs; 661 columns; 14 controls; no new kappa`. Add `--native` for the C++17/Boost checks; `BOOST_INCLUDE` selects a nonstandard header directory.

Validation completed:

- Both bounded searches regenerate exactly: 192,282 ordered pairs each; 2,298 positive candidates; the star pass accepts 221 edges, skips 2,053 overlaps and rejects 24 precision overruns. One greedy pass per class, with no optimality claim.
- Independent set-valued reconstruction and complete/D replay on all 661 symbolic input columns, five words and both directions; 14 mathematical/accounting controls and eight package tests.
- Unchanged native 5/9/11-stage checks for PR589, PR915 and the candidate: 883/1,327/1,549 formal columns per word and 144 bridge controls. Complete receipts match after an optimized isolated replay from a read-only minimal closure populated with refreshed main sources. Source pins, selected-record checks and staged whitespace pass.
- One isolated exact-base `make verify` attempt reached its predeclared 180-second budget in the inherited h=57 partial-swap producer. Its log is retained; **no full-suite pass is claimed**. Hosted CI is separate.

**Scope:** original syntactic H2 and literal `K_equals_D` remain false, as in PR915/926. Their predicates are unchanged. This package supplies the semantic arbitrary-dirty-input D boundary. Full hosted emission/audit, semantic supplier admission, complete invoices and outer assembly remain open. The recursive profile and selected frontier are unchanged; all inherited compiler, realization, hosting, precision/tape and analytic assumptions remain.

**Concurrent work and credit:** Ross Richardson's **PR965**, published during this run at `6292e3774abd82f2d5202190b498f35cc1628c39`, extends frozen PR926 pairs using general GL(3,2) bases and reaches 11,840 ADDs. This independently constructed global star pass reaches **57 fewer ADDs**, with less precision margin. No priority for three-helper bases, imported PR965 code or replay of that package is claimed. Sagar Thakrar's **PR753** previously used restored stars in historical R420 phase-A decoders and is credited as a mechanism predecessor. Gareth Davidson's PR915/926 and PR941, Scott Woolsey Biggart's PR733, Greer Guthrie, Mikhail R. Gadelha, commdata2338, DreamingOfClouds, eumemic and the native-checker lineage retain attribution in NOTICE.md.

OS-random assignment seed **19**, bit-supplier track. Exact research base: **007664306fff84fbb1c9a1b4053b69f439764034**. Upstream advanced to PR942 at `bbc600db2fc15007b7c914f4f2b2ed55fa909c87`; all 33 consumed runtime/proof inputs are unchanged. The original selected record is preserved as immutable local context, so the moving frontier does not break this verifier. No pinned coordination issue existed; the scope claim and result are local. Source hashes, exact certificates, proof, coverage and validation receipts are included.

Prepared for **Sricharan Vagvala (@theon199)** with substantial **OpenAI Codex assistance** in research, mathematics, implementation, verification and writing. Apache-2.0. No independent human or subagent review claimed.
title: Finite bit construction: restored helper stars save 197 R439 ADDs (no new kappa)
